Thanks — adding technical specifics below. Notes are intentionally conservative for enterprise VPCs.

Staging endpoints (TLS):
- api-staging-us.redwood.ai (443) — primary
- api-staging-us-2.redwood.ai (443) — failover/burst

Recommended allowlist (egress to Redwood):
- 35.189.72.0/24 (primary egress cluster)
- 34.120.46.0/24 (batching/stream cluster)
- 34.120.47.0/25 (monitoring/health checks)

API key provisioning:
- Provide a sandbox owner username (e.g., ops+test@brightledger.com) and we will create an api_key scoped to the "poc-sandbox" role. Keys are ephemeral by default (30 days) and we rotate on request.
- If you need HSM/KMS integration for key injection, advise now and we can schedule time with our security team.

Load test guidance (dry-run):
- 10-minute smoke window, concurrent virtual users: 8, requests/s target: 12 rps (prompt sequences ~180 tokens average). Goal is to validate routing/fallback and KV cache priming — not to stress GPUs.

Prompt review:
- Please upload your canonical prompt templates to the shared Drive folder (link below). We'll run a short A/B with a baseline prompt and your edited prompt during the dry-run.

I've attached a small "staging-credentials-template.txt" you can fill and return.

—Diego
